description: Trust anchor for the review-thread captures. Each file is a verbatim GraphQL reviewThreads response from maintainer/music-dj-tools, captured Mon 31 Aug 2026. Thread objects are byte-identical to what the API returned; the only edits were selecting a subset of threads and dropping the pageInfo cursor. Tests verify these checksums BEFORE parsing, so an accidental edit fails loudly instead of silently becoming the authoritative capture.
regenerate: Re-capture from the API with scripts/review_thread_triage.py's _THREADS_QUERY and recompute this manifest. Never hand-edit a payload.

pr-525-debtlog.json.note: Captured Wed 2 Sep 2026, separately from the Mon 31 Aug 2026 batch above -- the one real, RESOLVED, non-blocking DEBT-LOGGED thread (discussion_r3897291255) needed as the #792/#805 render-level control, replacing a synthetic _thread_node() (#805 round 10-continued-2, Codex, discussion_r3919026031).

pr-1658.json.note: Captured Thu 10 Sep 2026. Codex's BRACKETED marker shape -- '[BLOCKING] Close every started load span' -- which the offset-zero anchor read as 'unmarked'. Two of the five are P2 [BLOCKING], i.e. a reviewer-declared blocker that the MERGE WITH P2s OPEN rule would have let a merge debt-log away.

pr-1600.json.note: Captured Thu 10 Sep 2026. The CONTROL for the opposite error: real BRACKETED '[NON-BLOCKING]' headlines that must keep reading NON-BLOCKING. A substring test for BLOCKING finds it inside NON-BLOCKING at offset 4 and turns both of these into merge blockers.

pr-4240.json.note: Captured Tue 29 Sep 2026 14:43Z at head 25ac3b7d95 with _THREADS_QUERY via `gh api graphql`; the six threads opened by GitHub Copilot's reviewer, whose GraphQL login is `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` with no [bot] suffix (REST spells the same author `Copilot` on pulls/4240/comments and `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]` on pulls/4240/reviews). Five say 'P1 BLOCKING', one 'P2 NON-BLOCKING', in plain text leading the headline. The gate ignored all six before this login joined BOT_LOGINS. All six are resolved with a FIXED reply by now.
